subject: Post-demo econ recap + rebate request for EmberAI
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Björn Olsen <bjorn@emberai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo econ recap + next steps

Hi Björn — great to demo with you today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we’re aligned on next steps: 

- Workload shape: mostly short chat requests (avg seq ~180 tokens) with a smaller set of long-context document-summaries (~1k tokens) used for indexing flows.
- Initial monthly run-rate you called out: ~5M tokens/month with a 6-mo smoothing plan that could ramp to ~18M total tokens across six months.
- Budget target: you mentioned a target blended cost of roughly $250–$300 per 1M tokens (including embeddings/aux calls).

What we’ll do next (action items):
1) I attached a simple pricing worksheet (EmberAI_Pricing_Worksheet.xlsx) that maps your projected mix to per-1M token unit costs across our pricing tiers. Please drop in any alternate assumptions.
2) Please confirm whether the initial 5M/mo is committed (reserved) or just expected usage for the first two months — that will determine whether a committed-use discount path is viable.
3) We can offer a startup incentive (one-time credits + accelerated tiering) — I attached our Redwood_Startup_Terms.pdf. If EmberAI qualifies (basic requirements below), we typically layer a credit + a short-duration committed discount to bridge runway.

Qualification checklist for the startup program (one-liner for procurement): company < 24 months from seed close or <$10M ARR; primary use is user-facing product; reference customer interest ok. If you already have procurement constraints, put Sarah (procurement) on copy and we’ll tailor the paperwork.

If it helps, Marissa will propose two priced scenarios: (A) a startup-credit-heavy path that assumes no long-term commit and (B) a 12-mo committed path with a steeper $/1M token target. Can you confirm a good time tomorrow for a 30-min follow-up with procurement and Marissa?

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: EmberAI_Pricing_Worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_Startup_Terms.pdf (PDF)

From: Björn Olsen <bjorn@emberai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.procurement@emberai.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo econ recap + next steps

Thanks Hannah — helpful recap. Confirming the numbers from our side:
- Current expectation: ~5M tokens/month initially (user chat).
- Ramp plan: total ~18M tokens across the first 6 months (gradual ramp).
- Budget band: we’re targeting ~$250–$300 per 1M tokens as a blended target.

A couple clarifying questions:
1) Is the startup program a pure credit (one-time) or does it include temporary tiered pricing?
2) If we move to a 12-month committed plan, what net $/1M do you project at our volumes?
3) We need a procurement-friendly one-pager showing the proposed discount + term so Sarah can fast-track internal approval.

Looping Sarah in for procurement — Sarah, can you confirm whether EmberAI needs a PO and whether our legal team needs an NDA or MSA before vendor quotes?

-Björn

Subject: Re: Post-demo econ recap + next steps — pricing scenarios

Björn — thanks for confirming. Based on the mix you shared I sketched two distinct, procurement-ready scenarios below (high-level numbers; I’ll send an exported quote doc right after):

Scenario A — Startup path (no long-term commit):
- One-time startup credit: $12,000 applied to usage over the first 3 months.
- Metered pricing: standard hosted tiers; blended effective rate (with credit) lands near $260–$290 per 1M tokens in month 1, trending toward $300/1M once credit is consumed.
- Good for teams that need runway without lock-in.

Scenario B — 12-month committed path (recommended if you can commit to ~5M/mo baseline):
- 12-mo reserved commitment for 5M tokens/month.
- Committed discount target: $220 per 1M tokens blended (embeddings and generation combined), with a 6-mo early ramp clause to credit overage if you come in under baseline in the first two months.
- Net effective reduction vs. list: ~25–30% depending on exact mix + any startup credit applied.

Multi-year/multi-term note: we can discuss an additional rebate for a 24- or 36-month commitment, but typically that requires legal/sales ops review and a minimum ARR/commit threshold.

Next steps from us:
- I will attach a quick PDF quote (proposed-quote-EMB-2380.pdf) with the two scenarios by EOD.
- Hannah, can you confirm procurement availability for a 30-min call Wednesday to review the quote with Sarah?

-Marissa Cole
